note: THE TOP PRESET. Fresh ledger, its own three secured vein-hunter claims behind it, rung 3 earned the same way. Every cell here is one I watched a building stand on this morning on this exact map: (-8,7), (-2,-7), (7,7) took turrets and (-5,7) took a beacon. All four turrets go on proven ground, spaced >=3.0wu (turret+turret needs >2.4). The one unproven cell is the cheap beacon at (2,-7), 4.0 clear of the turret at (-2,-7) and 3.5 from the seam site at (-1.5,-6.4) — 25 gold is the right price for an experiment. Wave triggers only, two apart, each clearing its own cost; the 125 rung gets wave 9 and the fullest purse of the run because it is the order that has died three times today.
